scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @tile/server" "npm run dev -w @tile/client"
scripts.build: npm run build:rust && npm run build -w @tile/server && npm run build -w @tile/client
scripts.test: npm run build:rust && npm run test:rust && npm run test -w @tile/server
scripts.benchmark: npm run build:rust && npm run benchmark -w @tile/server && npm run benchmark:world -w @tile/server && npm run benchmark:pipeline -w @tile/server
